post_title: How many advance votes will have been cast in New Zealand's 2026 general election through 29 October 2026 (the fourth day of advance voting)?

question.title: How many advance votes will have been cast in New Zealand's 2026 general election through 29 October 2026 (the fourth day of advance voting)?
question.description:
New Zealand's 2026 General Election is held on Saturday 7 November 2026. Advance (early) in-person voting runs from Monday 26 October 2026 to Friday 6 November 2026. For the first time in over a decade, voters cannot enrol or update their details during the voting period: the enrolment deadline is midnight, Sunday 25 October 2026. Advance voting has become the dominant mode of voting in New Zealand — roughly 61% of all votes in 2023 were cast in advance (1,762,490 advance votes), up from 47% in 2017.

The Electoral Commission publishes daily advance voting statistics during the voting period, updated each day, showing the number of in-person votes taken before election day (excluding overseas votes); these are collected informally from voting places and may differ slightly from the official count. In 2023, advance voting began on Monday 2 October (12 days before the 14 October election day). Through the first three days of advance voting in 2023, 204,191 advance votes had been cast (compared with 264,744 over the equivalent period in 2020). Daily totals grew over the advance-voting period as election day approached.

In 2026, advance voting again spans 12 days, opening on 26 October ahead of the 7 November election. Thursday 29 October 2026 is the fourth day of advance voting. The cumulative total through that day depends on how quickly voters turn out early — a pattern that varies year to year and is influenced by weather, campaign dynamics, and the removal of election-day enrolment, which may push some voters to act earlier. As of 1 October 2026, about 3.68 million people were enrolled (around 90.8% of the estimated eligible population), broadly comparable to the 3.69 million enrolled at the 2023 election.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves to the cumulative number of advance votes cast in New Zealand's 2026 General Election from the opening of advance voting on Monday 26 October 2026 through and including Thursday 29 October 2026, as reported by the New Zealand Electoral Commission's daily advance voting statistics for the 2026 General Election (the 2026 equivalent of https://elections.nz/democracy-in-nz/historical-events/2023-general-election/voting-statistics, accessible via the Commission's statistics hub at https://elections.nz/stats-and-research). The figure is the cumulative total of in-person advance votes taken within New Zealand before election day, excluding overseas votes, consistent with how the Commission reports these daily statistics. For example, a reported cumulative total of 287,500 advance votes through 29 October resolves as 287500. If the Commission reports only daily figures, the resolution value is the sum of the daily figures for 26, 27, 28 and 29 October 2026.
question.fine_print: The relevant figure is the Commission's cumulative advance-vote count for the period up to and including 29 October 2026 as published on its daily voting-statistics page for the 2026 General Election; the Commission notes these daily figures are collected informally from voting places and may not match the later official count, and this informal daily figure is what resolves the question. If the Commission's own page is unavailable, equivalent figures reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) sourced to the Electoral Commission will be used. If the Commission ceases publishing daily advance-vote statistics for 2026 and no equivalent figure for the period through 29 October is available anywhere, the question is annulled.
